title: Order Flow Imbalance & Price Impact (Cont, Kukanov & Stoikov)
holding_period: seconds; a quote-adjustment and impact-measurement input rather than a standalone holding-period strategy
signal_frequency: per quote update; aggregated to 10-second intervals in the source
data_requirements: level-1 quote data with best bid/ask price and size (TAQ or equivalent)
timestamped quote updates at sub-second resolution
trade prints with buy/sell classification, only for the trade-imbalance comparison
per-instrument re-estimation - beta does not transfer across instruments or timescales

sources.citation: Cont, R., Kukanov, A., & Stoikov, S. The price impact of order book events. arXiv:1011.6402 (March 2011 draft); published in Journal of Financial Econometrics 12(1), 47-88 (2014).
Kyle, A. S. (1985). Continuous Auctions and Insider Trading. Econometrica, 53(6), 1315-1335. (The theoretical ancestor of linear price impact.)
Almgren, R., & Chriss, N. (2000). Optimal execution of portfolio transactions. Journal of Risk, 3(2), 5-39.
